meta.name: instagram-profile-meta
meta.description: Fetches Instagram user profile metadata including bio, follower count, following count, post count, verification status and other profile details. Use when user mentions Instagram profile info, user stats, account details, follower count, bio scraping, Instagram user data, IG profile, check Instagram account, Instagram user info, how many followers does someone have on Instagram, get Instagram profile, Instagram account metadata.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取任意 Instagram 用户的公开个人资料数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取 Instagram 账号的粉丝数、简介等公开信息。
copy.tagline_en: Fetch public Instagram profile data for any user
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to retrieve public Instagram stats like follower count and bio.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能获取 Instagram 用户的公开资料元数据，包括简介、粉丝数、关注数、帖子数、认证状态等。
howto.when: 当用户询问某个 Instagram 账号的粉丝数、简介、认证状态等资料信息时触发。

say.note: Claude 会返回该账号的粉丝数等资料。

say.text: 这个 Instagram 账号是认证的吗？
say.note: Claude 会检查并告知认证状态。

say.text: 获取 @nasa 的简介和帖子数
say.note: Claude 会返回简介和帖子数量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch public Instagram user profile metadata including bio, follower count, following count, post count, verification status, and other profile details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about an Instagram account's follower count, bio, verification status, or other profile metadata.

say_en.note: Claude will return the follower count and other profile data.
Claude will check and tell the verification status.

say_en.text: Get the bio and post count of @nasa
say_en.note: Claude will return the bio and number of posts.
